content: Shared HM modules: write user-level config as importable HM modules in one dir (e.g. home/); on NixOS wire via home-manager.users.<name>.imports (or home-manager.sharedModules) after importing home-manager.nixosModules.home-manager; standalone via home-manager.lib.homeManagerConfiguration modules. Same module namespace (class homeManager) in both -> portable modules; extraSpecialArgs injects inputs in both paths. Avoid NixOS-only options inside home modules.
